## Frequently asked questions

Is BombBomb Engage SOC 2 Type II certified?

Yes. BombBomb maintains SOC 2 Type II compliance, which means we follow strict controls for security, availability, and confidentiality. This certification is audited annually by independent third parties.

Can I control who has access to specific videos?

Yes. You can lock videos so only you can view them, add password protection for authorized viewers only, or set expiration dates that automatically remove access after a specific time. These controls work on individual videos or can be set as defaults.

How do video passwords and expiration dates work?

Video passwords require viewers to enter a password before watching. Expiration dates automatically make videos inaccessible after your chosen date and time. Both features can be enabled per video and work together for maximum security.

Can admins set privacy controls at the organizational level?

Yes. Admins can establish default privacy settings across the organization, control user permissions by role, and set governance policies that ensure compliance with your company’s security requirements.

Where is video data stored?

All video data is stored in fully encrypted cloud storage that meets industry compliance standards. Data is securely stored in the U.S., encrypted both in transit and at rest, with access controls and monitoring in place to protect against unauthorized access.
